content: Dettol, also known as parachlorometaxylenol (PCMX), is a commercial liquid antiseptic that is part of a product line manufactured by Reckitt Benckiser. It is marketed in regions such as South Asia, Africa, the Middle East, Asia Pacific, Europe, and Australasia. The primary active ingredient responsible for its antiseptic properties is chloroxylenol, an aromatic chemical compound with the molecular formula C8H9ClO. This compound constitutes 8% of Dettol's total composition, while the remaining components include pine oil, isopropanol, castor oil soap, caramel, and water. Due to the insolubility of some of its ingredients in water, Dettol forms a white emulsion of oil droplets when diluted for use. It has a distinctive phenolic odor, which is reminiscent of trichlorophenol and the explosive compound trinitrotoluene (TNT). Dettol is characterized by its low toxicity and minimal corrosive effects on metals. It is also relatively inexpensive compared to other disinfectants and exhibits broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity. It is effective against gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria, fungi, yeast, mildew, and even methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), commonly referred to as a superbug. Studies using agar patch tests have demonstrated that Dettol can eliminate 98% of microbes within just 15 seconds. It achieves this by disrupting the membrane potential of bacterial cells, which severely impairs their ability to produce adenosine triphosphate (ATP), ultimately leading to rapid cell death. Dettol can also be used in small quantities to treat acne. The bottle cap of Dettol is designed to serve as a measuring container, allowing users to pour increments of 10 milliliters for various applications. However, like other household cleaning agents, Dettol is toxic and should never be ingested. In one extreme case, a 42-year-old man in England died from overexposure to Dettol in May 2007. Overuse of Dettol can also contribute to bacterial resistance. Nevertheless, the risk of infection can be significantly reduced when Dettol is used in conjunction with soap and water.
